modmenu.descriptionTranslation.silent_kn: Client-side SPA knocking: asynchronously sends a standard fwknop UDP knock before connecting to a server protected by fwknopd, then carries on with the vanilla connection once the firewall has let your address through.
silent_knock.button.tooltip: Choose a fwknoprc config file (only the path is stored)
silent_knock.button.tooltip.bound: Current key file: %s (click to choose another)
silent_knock.button.unbind.tooltip: Only unbind this server; the key file stays on your computer
silent_knock.create.access.tooltip: Follows the server port in the address field; extra ports are knocked on demand at runtime, no need to put them here
silent_knock.create.allow_ip.tooltip: Only used with Custom: the IP address fwknopd should open for
silent_knock.create.copy.tooltip: Copy the whole fwknoprc content to the clipboard
silent_knock.create.hint: Not sure what the other options do? Just fill in the two keys, keep the defaults and hit Save.
silent_knock.create.hint.access: One knock opens the port you are connecting to. Extra ports for voice chat and friends do not belong in this file: the mod adds the voice port automatically, and any other port can be knocked in game via ESC → SPA knock.
silent_knock.create.hint.gpg: Only HMAC mode is supported; a config with USE_GPG is reported as unsupported.
silent_knock.create.hmac.label: HMAC key (Base64)
silent_knock.create.invalid_access: Access ports look like tcp/25565; separate several entries with commas
silent_knock.create.invalid_port: SPA port must be a number between 1 and 65535
silent_knock.create.key.label: Rijndael key (Base64)
silent_knock.create.key.tooltip: The KEY_BASE64 value from fwknop --key-gen, the Rijndael key
silent_knock.create.name: File name
silent_knock.create.port.tooltip: fwknopd's SPA listening port, 62201 by default; only change it if your server does
silent_knock.create.save.tooltip: Save as .fwknoprc and bind it to this server
silent_knock.create.storage: Saved as plain text in .minecraft/silentknock/keys, usable with the fwknop client too
silent_knock.create.title: New fwknoprc config
silent_knock.disconnect.clock_skew.ahead: System clock: your computer is %s s ahead of internet time (tolerance %s s). fwknop drops knocks whose timestamp is too old, so the knock may have been ignored.
silent_knock.disconnect.clock_skew.behin: System clock: your computer is %s s behind internet time (tolerance %s s). fwknop drops knocks whose timestamp is off, so the knock may have been ignored.
silent_knock.disconnect.knock_failed_hin: The knock packet never left your computer, so the server never opened its door for your IP. Check the key file and the SPA port.
silent_knock.disconnect.knock_sent_hint: The knock packet was sent but the connection still failed: wrong key, wrong SPA port, or the server has not let your IP in yet.
silent_knock.key.enc_damaged: The encrypted key file is damaged
silent_knock.key.enc_no_keyring: This key file is encrypted, and the keyring on this computer cannot open it
silent_knock.key.enc_wrong_key: Cannot decrypt this key file: it was created on another computer
silent_knock.key.gpg_unsupported: This config uses GPG encryption (USE_GPG); this mod only supports HMAC mode
silent_knock.knock.button.tooltip: Temporarily knock an extra port (voice chat etc.) without editing the config
silent_knock.knock.detected: Detected %s: its port is knocked automatically when you connect
silent_knock.knock.empty: Type a port first, e.g. udp/24454
silent_knock.knock.hint: This only opens the ports temporarily and never writes to any config file. How long they stay open is up to the server's fwknopd (usually about 30 seconds); knock again if you need more time. The examples below are the default ports of common mods; change the number if your server uses a different one.
silent_knock.knock.invalid: Write ports like udp/24454, separated by commas
silent_knock.knock.no_server: Not on a multiplayer server, nothing to knock
silent_knock.knock.ports.tooltip: Like udp/24454; separate several with commas
silent_knock.knock.preset.filled: Filled in %s; press Knock to send
silent_knock.knock.send.tooltip: Knock once now; the server opens these ports for a short while
silent_knock.knock.title: On-demand knock
silent_knock.msg.clock_skew.ahead: [SPA] Your computer clock is %s s ahead of internet time (SPA tolerance: %s s). SPA knocks may be dropped; sync the clock in your system settings.
silent_knock.msg.clock_skew.behind: [SPA] Your computer clock is %s s behind internet time (SPA tolerance: %s s). SPA knocks may be dropped; sync the clock in your system settings.
silent_knock.msg.extra_cooldown: [SPA] %s was knocked just now, try again in %s s
silent_knock.msg.extra_no_key: [SPA] %s has no SPA key file, no knock needed
silent_knock.msg.extra_no_server: [SPA] Not on a multiplayer server, cannot knock
silent_knock.msg.extra_sent: [SPA] Temporarily opened: %s (the server decides for how long, usually about 30 s; knock again if needed)
silent_knock.msg.key_invalid: [SPA] Key file problem: %s (SPA will be skipped when connecting)
silent_knock.msg.no_key: [SPA] %s has no key file, connecting directly
silent_knock.msg.sent: [SPA] Knock sent, %s ms until connecting to %s
silent_knock.picker.create.tooltip: Enter two Base64 keys and the options to produce a fwknoprc file
silent_knock.picker.empty: No usable files in this folder
silent_knock.picker.hint: Click a file to bind it; only its absolute path is stored in NBT
silent_knock.picker.title: Choose an SPA config file
silent_knock.port.tooltip: fwknopd SPA port; leave empty to use the config value
silent_knock.settings.button.tooltip: SilentSPA settings: notifications, sounds and how long to wait after knocking
silent_knock.settings.hint: Every change is saved to config/silent_knock.json right away. Open this screen again from Options - SilentSPA.
silent_knock.settings.title: SilentSPA settings
silent_knock.settings.toast_mode.all.des: Toasts on every screen; chat lines too when in game
silent_knock.settings.toast_mode.ingame_: In game only chat lines; toasts only in menus
Completely quiet while playing; toasts only in menus
No toasts, no chat lines, no sounds
silent_knock.toast.auto_knock.title: %s mod detected
